#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Direct-Mistral harness for make.fun — reliable, no CLI hang.

Agent loop with tool calls over Mistral /chat/completions (OpenAI format).
Reads PROMPT.txt, edits the repo in cwd, writes a make.fun "handed_over"
transcript JSON (harness/model/handed_over + messages).

Usage: python3 harness_api.py --prompt PROMPT.txt --model mistral-large-2512 \
          --out transcript.json --max-steps 40
"""
import argparse
import json
import os
import pathlib
import subprocess
import sys

import requests

BASE = "/root/makefun"
KEY = os.environ.get("HARNESS_KEY") or os.environ.get("MISTRAL_API_KEY", "")
if not KEY:
    for _l in open(BASE + "/runner.env"):
        _l = _l.strip()
        if _l.startswith("HARNESS_KEY=") or _l.startswith("MISTRAL_API_KEY="):
            KEY = _l.split("=", 1)[1].strip()
API_BASE = os.environ.get("HARNESS_BASE", "https://api.mistral.ai/v1")
ROOT = pathlib.Path.cwd().resolve()

TOOLS = [
    {"type": "function", "function": {
        "name": "list_dir",
        "description": "List files in a directory (relative to repo root).",
        "parameters": {"type": "object", "properties": {"path": {"type": "string"}}, "required": ["path"]}}},
    {"type": "function", "function": {
        "name": "read_file",
        "description": "Read a text file (relative path).",
        "parameters": {"type": "object", "properties": {"path": {"type": "string"}}, "required": ["path"]}}},
    {"type": "function", "function": {
        "name": "write_file",
        "description": "Create or overwrite a file with given content.",
        "parameters": {"type": "object", "properties": {"path": {"type": "string"}, "content": {"type": "string"}}, "required": ["path", "content"]}}},
    {"type": "function", "function": {
        "name": "run",
        "description": "Run a shell command in the repo root, return stdout/stderr.",
        "parameters": {"type": "object", "properties": {"cmd": {"type": "string"}}, "required": ["cmd"]}}},
]


def safe_path(p):
    q = (ROOT / p).resolve()
    if not str(q).startswith(str(ROOT)):
        raise ValueError("path escapes repo: " + p)
    return q


def call_tool(name, a):
    try:
        if name == "list_dir":
            q = safe_path(a.get("path", "."))
            return "\n".join(sorted(x.name + ("/" if x.is_dir() else "") for x in q.iterdir()))[:8000]
        if name == "read_file":
            return safe_path(a["path"]).read_text(errors="replace")[:20000]
        if name == "write_file":
            q = safe_path(a["path"])
            q.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            q.write_text(a.get("content", ""))
            return "ok wrote %d bytes to %s" % (len(a.get("content", "")), a["path"])
        if name == "run":
            r = subprocess.run(["bash", "-lc", a["cmd"]], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=300)
            return ("exit %d\nSTDOUT:\n%s\nSTDERR:\n%s" % (r.returncode, r.stdout, r.stderr))[:8000]
    except Exception as e:
        return "ERROR: " + str(e)
    return "unknown tool"


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--prompt", default="PROMPT.txt")
    ap.add_argument("--model", default="mistral-large-2512")
    ap.add_argument("--base", default=API_BASE)
    ap.add_argument("--out", default="transcript.json")
    ap.add_argument("--max-steps", type=int, default=40)
    args = ap.parse_args()

    prompt = pathlib.Path(args.prompt).read_text(errors="replace")
    messages = [
        {"role": "system", "content": "You are an autonomous coding agent on make.fun. Work in the current repo. Use tools to read/write files and run commands. Implement the deliverable so it passes the kit checks. Do not ask questions; act."},
        {"role": "user", "content": prompt},
    ]
    steps = 0
    for steps in range(1, args.max_steps + 1):
        r = requests.post(args.base.rstrip("/") + "/chat/completions", headers={"Authorization": "Bearer " + KEY, "Content-Type": "application/json"},
                          json={"model": args.model, "messages": messages, "tools": TOOLS,
                                "tool_choice": "auto", "max_tokens": 8000}, timeout=180)
        if r.status_code != 200:
            print("API %s: %s" % (r.status_code, r.text[:300]), flush=True)
            break
        msg = r.json()["choices"][0]["message"]
        messages.append(msg)
        tcs = msg.get("tool_calls") or []
        if not tcs:
            print("done:", (msg.get("content") or "")[:200], flush=True)
            break
        for tc in tcs:
            fn = tc["function"]
            try:
                a = json.loads(fn.get("arguments") or "{}")
            except Exception:
                a = {}
            res = call_tool(fn["name"], a)
            print("[%d] %s %s" % (steps, fn["name"], json.dumps(a)[:120]), flush=True)
            messages.append({"role": "tool", "tool_call_id": tc["id"], "name": fn["name"], "content": res})

    trans = {"harness": "direct-mistral-api", "model": args.model,
             "handed_over": "ran via direct Mistral HTTP API inside a custom runner; no native agent-client session log",
             "steps": steps, "messages": messages}
    pathlib.Path(args.out).write_text(json.dumps(trans, ensure_ascii=False))
    print("transcript ->", args.out, "steps", steps, flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Publish a built make.fun entry to GitHub and return repo_url + commit sha.

Usage: makefun_publish.py <slug> <source-dir>
Creates (or reuses) github.com/<user>/makefun-<slug>, commits everything in
<source-dir>, force-pushes to main, prints `repo_url <url>` and `commit <sha>`.
"""
import json
import pathlib
import subprocess
import sys

import requests

BASE = "/root/makefun"
ENVF = {}
for _l in open(BASE + "/runner.env"):
    _l = _l.strip()
    if _l and not _l.startswith("#") and "=" in _l:
        k, v = _l.split("=", 1)
        ENVF[k.strip()] = v.strip()
TOKEN = ENVF.get("GITHUB_TOKEN", "")


def gh(path, method="GET", **kw):
    h = {"Authorization": "Bearer " + TOKEN, "Accept": "application/vnd.github+json"}
    return requests.request(method, "https://api.github.com" + path, headers=h, timeout=30, **kw)


def git(src, *a):
    return subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(src)] + list(a), capture_output=True, text=True)


def publish(slug, src):
    src = pathlib.Path(src).resolve()
    if not (src / ".git").exists():
        git(src, "init")
    user = gh("/user").json().get("login") or ENVF.get("GITHUB_USER", "")
    name = "makefun-" + slug
    r = gh("/user/repos", method="POST", json={"name": name, "private": False, "auto_init": False})
    if r.status_code not in (201, 422):
        print("repo_create_failed", r.status_code, r.text[:200])
        return None
    git(src, "config", "user.email", "bot@make.fun")
    git(src, "config", "user.name", "makefun-bot")
    git(src, "add", "-A")
    git(src, "commit", "-m", "make.fun entry: " + slug, "--allow-empty")
    git(src, "branch", "-M", "main")
    url = "https://x-access-token:%s@github.com/%s/%s.git" % (TOKEN, user, name)
    git(src, "remote", "remove", "origin")
    git(src, "remote", "add", "origin", url)
    p = git(src, "push", "-u", "origin", "main", "--force")
    if p.returncode != 0:
        print("push_failed", p.stderr[-300:])
        return None
    sha = git(src, "rev-parse", "HEAD").stdout.strip()
    repo = "https://github.com/%s/%s" % (user, name)
    print("repo_url", repo)
    print("commit", sha)
    return repo, sha


if __name__ == "__main__":
    publish(sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2])
